file: 1002 spaceuk - From Number 1 to Exposed to Legit.mp4
title: spaceuk: From #1 Player, to Exposed, to Legit

lines.t: He was the best Geometry Dash player in the world. He beat the hardest levels in the game, one after another, sometimes one a day.
He won Best Player at the Geometry Dash Awards. Twice.
And almost all of it was fake.
This is the story of spaceuk. How he got to the top, how he got caught, and how he came back and did it for real.
spaceuk, who used to go by Mumzy, is a player from England. He made his YouTube channel in 2015, but he didn't really start posting until August 2020.
lines.say: Space U K, who used to go by Mumzy, is a player from England. He made his YouTube channel in 2015, but he didn't really start posting until August 2020.

lines.t: And then he got good. Really good. Really fast. So fast that some people doubted him right away.
In December 2020, he beat The Golden. It was only his fifth demon, and it was number two on the Demonlist.
Going from easy demons to the second hardest level in the game that quickly is almost unheard of. His fame exploded.
After that, he beat the top levels in record time, averaging about one a day.
In October 2021, he joined the race to beat Slaughterhouse, the number one hardest level.
He finished it in just over a week, on October 24th.
On May 7th, 2022, he beat Sephiroth, which meant he had beaten the entire main Demonlist. Only one player had done that before him: nSwish.
lines.say: On May seventh, 2022, he beat Sephiroth, which meant he had beaten the entire main Demon list. Only one player had done that before him: En swish.

lines.t: He won Best Player at the Geometry Dash Awards in 2021 and again in 2022. As far as everyone knew, he was the best.
But there were strange moments.
On June 19th, 2022, he suddenly made most of his videos private, deactivated his Twitter, and asked for his Demonlist profile to be removed.
After the backlash, he put everything back the very next day.
A player named Kolo noticed something wrong in spaceuk's Slaughterhouse videos. Click delays. Parts that looked cut. He uploaded two videos about it.
lines.say: A player named Kolo noticed something wrong in Space U K's Slaughterhouse videos. Click delays. Parts that looked cut. He uploaded two videos about it.

lines.t: The community brushed him off. The Demonlist team said there wasn't enough evidence, and one moderator messaged him: You are wrong.
Meanwhile, spaceuk kept going. He was reportedly the first victor of Aerial Gleam, Abyss of Darkness and Acheron, and claimed the lowest attempt count on Kyouki, around 13,500.
lines.say: Meanwhile, Space U K kept going. He was reportedly the first victor of Aerial Gleam, Abyss of Darkness and Acheron, and claimed the lowest attempt count on Kyouki, around 13,500.

lines.t: In early 2023, he was picked to verify Banshee, an old impossible level from 2014. On March 28th, he posted a 60 percent run.
Then on April 1st, his progress videos were unlisted, and he said he was quitting the level. People thought it was an April Fools joke.
That same month, someone contacted spaceuk, said they knew him, and claimed he was hacking.
lines.say: That same month, someone contacted Space U K, said they knew him, and claimed he was hacking.

lines.t: paqoe, a head moderator on the Demonlist, started checking his videos with the rest of the team.
lines.say: Pack-o, a head moderator on the Demon list, started checking his videos with the rest of the team.

lines.t: They couldn't find the hacking method the person described. But they found something else.
In his Acheron video, the sound of his clicks didn't match what his icon was doing on screen.
His records were removed. Then, a few hours later, they were put back. There just wasn't enough proof yet.
But paqoe kept digging, and found the same problem in his other videos, like The Hallucination.
lines.say: But Pack-o kept digging, and found the same problem in his other videos, like The Hallucination.

lines.t: On April 25th, 2023, paqoe posted a video called Exposing SpaceUK.
lines.say: On April twenty-fifth, 2023, Pack-o posted a video called Exposing Space U K.

lines.t: spaceuk confessed on Twitter. He said he used a bot called zBot for every completion after Sephiroth, in May 2022. He said he got bored of the game and wanted to see how far he could go.
lines.say: Space U K confessed on Twitter. He said he used a bot called Z bot for every completion after Sephiroth, in May 2022. He said he got bored of the game and wanted to see how far he could go.

lines.t: But that wasn't true either. paqoe showed zBot in his recordings all the way back to March 2021.
lines.say: But that wasn't true either. Pack-o showed Z bot in his recordings all the way back to March 2021.

lines.t: In the end, he admitted to cheating on practically every record since The Golden.
So how did he fool everyone for two years?
The Demonlist had ways to catch bots. But spaceuk used a trick so simple it got past the whole team. He made real clicking noises over the bot.
And zBot left a hidden watermark. On the Level Complete screen, the text was 940 pixels wide instead of 1004.
Only the people who made zBot knew about it. Nobody checked, because nobody thought a player that good would ever use a bot.
According to other top players, his real hardest level was Kenos. He only started hacking after that, and he later confirmed it in an interview.
And Kolo? The Demonlist admitted he had been right all along, and apologized to him.
After he was exposed, spaceuk deleted his YouTube channel and deactivated his Twitter.
lines.say: After he was exposed, Space U K deleted his YouTube channel and deactivated his Twitter.

lines.t: Later, he came back to Twitter with a long apology. He said he wasn't asking for sympathy. He wanted to clear everything up, and apologize to the players he held back.
Titles went back to the players who had really earned them.
Most people thought that was the end of spaceuk. It wasn't.
lines.say: Most people thought that was the end of Space U K. It wasn't.

lines.t: He made a new YouTube channel and uploaded a legit completion of The Golden, with the full stream footage as proof.
On May 14th, 2023, he legitimately beat Tartarus. His new real hardest.
In June 2024, he got 33 percent on Kyouki, and some people were angry. They wanted him to quit the game for good.
In January 2025, he beat Down Bass and Sonic Wave. The comments were split. Some were cynical. Others wanted to give him a chance.
In September 2025, he did an interview with BenCar from Secret Way. He said he felt guilty for hacking.
He said what he regrets most is noclipping The Golden. He really thought he had beaten it at first, and when he found out he hadn't, he uploaded the noclip anyway.
And he made one more claim. He said paqoe, the player who exposed him, might have hacked Silent Clubstep. But he also said it was very likely untrue.
lines.say: And he made one more claim. He said Pack-o, the player who exposed him, might have hacked Silent Clubstep. But he also said it was very likely untrue.

lines.t: ItsCakes made a video about it, and paqoe responded. Most people did not buy it.
lines.say: Its Cakes made a video about it, and Pack-o responded. Most people did not buy it.

lines.t: Then he went back to the level that started his whole downfall. Acheron.
In September 2025, he got a 79 to 100 run on Thinking Space 2. Then he got a new keyboard and started streaming Acheron again.
68 percent. Then 30 to 100. Then 72 percent. By October, he was already around 88,000 attempts.
The level he once faked, he was now grinding for real, live, where everyone could see every click.
On January 3rd, 2026, spaceuk legitimately beat Acheron. After about 125,000 attempts.
lines.say: On January third, 2026, Space U K legitimately beat Acheron. After about one hundred twenty-five thousand attempts.

lines.t: Since then, he's been playing levels like Subterminal Point and Tidal Wave. Legit, on stream.
From number one, to the biggest scandal in Geometry Dash, to beating Acheron for real.
So what do you think? Should spaceuk be forgiven? Tell me in the comments.
lines.say: So what do you think? Should Space U K be forgiven? Tell me in the comments.
